name: Telecanor Global Limited
summary: TeleCanor Global Ltd. primarily focuses on internet-enabled voice recognition and interactive response technologies. The company is also active in developing essential banking software and digital payment infrastructure, with its overarching emphasis being on the information technology and telecommunications sectors. Its comprehensive service portfolio includes offerings such as digital payment processing, telecommunication solutions, financial institution support, enterprise resource planning (ERP), healthcare IT, strategic consulting, and mobile applications. Founded by Maruti Ram Praturi on July 22, 1991, TeleCanor Global operates from its headquarters in Hyderabad, India.
